title: Integrating Cloud NSS with Cloud-Based SIEMs

blocks.text: You can subscribe to Cloud NSS, enabling direct cloud-to-cloud log streaming of supported log types into a compatible cloud-based security information and event management (SIEM) system without any on-premises connectors. Instead of deploying, managing, and monitoring NSS VMs, you can configure an HTTPS API feed to push logs from the Zscaler cloud into an HTTPS API-based log collector on your SIEM. To learn more, see Understanding Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS).
The following guides detail the requirements and steps to integrate Cloud NSS with your SIEM:
